# Apache Software Foundation

> The Apache Software Foundation is a decentralized community of developers stewarding 200+ open-source projects under the Apache License, guided by the Apache Way principles of meritocracy and community governance.

Apache.org serves as the central hub for the ASF, providing project directories, community resources, governance documentation, and event information. The site emphasizes open-source collaboration, contributor development, and transparent organizational processes.

## Key Topics

- Apache Software Foundation (ASF)
- Apache Way
- Apache License 2.0
- Open-source projects
- Apache Incubator
- Meritocracy
- Community governance
- Code of Conduct
- Contributor License Agreements
- Project Management Committee (PMC)
- Community Over Code
- ASF Security Team
- Google Summer of Code
- Apache projects directory
- Software distribution

## Core Projects & Directory

- [ASF Open Source Projects](https://apache.org/projects): Directory of Apache open-source projects with incubator and top-level project listings
- [Apache Projects and Committees Directory](https://projects.apache.org): Comprehensive directory of all Apache projects, committees, and organizational structure
- [The Apache Incubator](https://incubator.apache.org): Apache Incubator program for new projects with governance, guides, and graduation path
- [Apache Software Foundation Downloads](https://downloads.apache.org): Apache Software Foundation project downloads and release repository directory
- [Apache Projects Releases](https://projects.apache.org/releases.html): Apache project releases listing and software distribution artifacts catalog

## Community & Contribution

- [Apache Community Development Hub](https://community.apache.org): ASF community development hub for newcomers, contributors, and open-source participation
- [Contributing to the Apache Software Foundation](https://community.apache.org/contributors): Guide to contributing to Apache projects with contributor ladder and getting started
- [Community Connect & Mentor](https://apache.org/community-resources): Community resources for mentoring, local chapters, and contributor development programs
- [Apache Software Foundation Mailing Lists](https://apache.org/foundation/mailinglists): ASF mailing list subscription management and community communication guidelines

## Governance & Values

- [How the ASF Works](https://apache.org/foundation/how-it-works): Guide to ASF governance, meritocracy, roles, and organizational structure
- [The Apache Way](https://apache.org/theapacheway): Apache Way briefing on community governance, meritocracy, and organizational values
- [Code of Conduct](https://apache.org/foundation/policies/conduct): ASF Code of Conduct establishing community guidelines and anti-harassment policies

## Events & News

- [Apache Software Foundation Events](https://events.apache.org): ASF events directory including ApacheCon, Roadshows, and Community over Code calendar
- [The ASF Blog](https://news.apache.org): ASF blog covering board elections, project announcements, and foundation updates
- [Introducing The ASF's New Logo](https://news.apache.org/foundation/entry/introducing-the-asfs-new-logo): ASF announces new logo rebrand reflecting Apache Way values and community identity

## Legal, Licensing & Security

- [Apache Licenses](https://apache.org/licenses): Apache License versions and Contributor License Agreements documentation
- [ASF Security Team](https://apache.org/security): Apache Security Team for vulnerability reporting, CVE numbering, and advisories
- [ASF Legal & Trademark](https://apache.org/legal): ASF legal information, trademark policy, licensing, and compliance guidelines

## Foundation Overview

- [Welcome to The Apache Software Foundation](https://apache.org): Apache Software Foundation homepage with projects, events, and community overview

## Optional

- [The Apache Attic](https://attic.apache.org): Apache Attic manages end-of-life projects and retirement processes for graduated projects
